mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the average rank IC over triggered periods falls below 0.10.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) drop of more than 10% in the same month indicates weakening aggregate demand, which depresses corporate revenue expectations and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < -2% AND HOUST < previous month - 10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails to activate in at least one observed recession.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase of 0.4 percentage points or more from the prior month, sustained for two consecutive months, signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which erode consumer purchasing power and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises by >= 0.4pp for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of 1% or more for three consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces input demand and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month - 1% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 35% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decrease of at least 0.25 percentage points in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a month-over-month increase of 1% in real savings deposits (RSAFS) indicates a flight to safety into liquid assets, which reduces risk appetite and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS drops >= 0.25pp AND RSAFS rises >= 1% MoM
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of triggered episodes, or the interaction is not statistically significant at p < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase of 2% or more in real personal income (PAYEMS) combined with a concurrent monthly rise of 1% or more in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals accelerating inflation with expanding incomes, which raises discount rates and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month + 2% AND CPIAUCSL > previous month + 1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered high-inflation months (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A consistent monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for four consecutive months indicates an extremely tight labor market, which elevates wage pressures and input costs, ultimately producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings growth offsets cost pressures.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase of at least 3% in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a concurrent monthly GDP growth (GDPC1 YoY QoQ change) above 2% signals a robust residential investment boom, which boosts construction-related equities and supports broader market gains, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous month + 3% AND GDPC1 YoY QoQ change > 2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).
